shots.title: THE CITY
shots.logline: Golden hour over sixty-storey canyons; the city holds its breath.

shots.title: THE PERCH
shots.logline: Two hundred and twenty-eight metres up, Vesper waits on the steel prow.

shots.title: THE DROP
shots.logline: He tips forward and lets the tower fall away.

shots.title: THE SWING
shots.logline: A line snaps taut above the traffic and the fall becomes flight.

shots.title: THREAD THE NEEDLE
shots.logline: Fourteen metres of air between two skybridges. He takes it at a hundred.

shots.title: APEX
shots.logline: Weightless against the sun, the whole city below him as the lights come on.

notes.hero_screen: x,y normalised from the top-left of the frame (chest); h = approximate height of the hero as a fraction of frame height
notes.telemetry: altitude above the street (m) and speed (km/h) of the hero; camera for s1
